content.description:
Who We Are & Why Join Us

Avathon is the leading Industrial AI autonomy platform, helping customers across heavy industries -- energy, mining, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, and logistics -- accelerate the journey toward autonomous operations. Our platform is built on a Computational Knowledge Graph foundation that contextualizes and connects operational data across siloed systems, bringing together time series, structured, unstructured, and machine vision data to power AI-driven applications in asset performance management, supply chain intelligence, visual AI, and global trade management. With capabilities spanning digital twins, normal behavior modeling, natural language processing, and computer vision, Avathon delivers real-time predictive intelligence and agentic decision-making at industrial scale.

Cutting-Edge AI Innovation -- Join a team at the forefront of AI, developing groundbreaking solutions that shape the future. High-Growth Environment -- Thrive in a fast-scaling startup where agility, collaboration, and rapid professional growth are the norm. Meaningful Impact -- Work on AI-driven projects that drive real change across industries and improve lives.

Learn more at: avathon.com

We are looking for a Product Manager, Energy & Critical Resources to help define and shape Avathon’s next generation of Physical AI products for the global energy and resources ecosystem spanning oil & gas, power and utilities, renewables, and mining. You will own product strategy for cutting-edge capabilities that apply agentic AI, operational intelligence, digital twins, predictive and prescriptive AI, and autonomous decision-making to some of industry’s hardest problems from asset reliability and production optimization to grid and field operations, maintenance, supply chains, and increasingly autonomous operations. Working alongside AI scientists, engineers, forward-deployed teams, and industry leaders, you will translate complex real-world operational challenges into scalable AI products capable of transforming how the world’s critical energy and resource infrastructure is operated.

What You'll Work On

Define and lead next-generation products that apply AI, operational intelligence, optimization, and autonomous decision-making to complex physical operations from concept and validation through launch, adoption, and scale

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities across asset reliability and integrity, predictive maintenance, production and process optimization, field operations, mine-to-mill operations, power generation optimization, grid operations, renewable asset performance, energy management, and operational planning

Partner with applied Science, Product and Forward-Deployed Engineering teams to transform agentic AI, predictive and prescriptive models, optimization, digital twins, computer vision, and decision intelligence into repeatable, scalable products for industrial environments

Define how Avathon’s computational knowledge graph connects assets, processes, people, operating conditions, maintenance, production, and enterprise data to give AI the context required to reason and make decisions across complex operations

Work directly with energy producers, miners, utilities, power generators and distributors, renewable operators, engineers, and frontline operational teams to deeply understand operating constraints, validate product concepts, and identify opportunities for transformational impact

Translate complex operational challenges into clear product capabilities, workflows, requirements, KPIs, and measurable outcomes such as increased availability, production and throughput; reduced downtime and cost; improved reliability and safety; and greater operational autonomy

Partner across Product Engineering, AI Research, Forward Deployed Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to take products from concept to production deployment and convert successful customer solutions into scalable product capabilities

Stay at the forefront of Physical AI, industrial autonomy, energy transition, grid modernization, mining technology, and emerging AI capabilities to identify new markets, product opportunities, and areas of differentiation for Avathon.

Measure product success through customer adoption, operational impact, AI performance, repeatability, and commercial scalability, using insights from live industrial deployments to continuously evolve the portfolio

Top of Form

Bottom of Form

What We’re Looking For:

MBA required from a top-tier university

4+ years of relevant experience in product management, management consulting, energy, mining, industrial technology, operations, or a related field

Strong understanding of the operating environment of energy, mining, metals, or other critical resource companies

Experience defining and deploying products incorporating AI, machine learning, optimization, or advanced analytics preferred

Strong ability to translate complex business problems into clear product requirements

Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder-management skills

Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior business stakeholders

Strong understanding of industrial and B2B operating environments preferred

Ability to operate with significant ownership in a fast-moving technology company

What You'll Learn

Within your first few years at Avathon, our goal is for you to develop an unusually powerful combination of skills: Deep technical fluency in AI, exceptional product judgment, understanding of complex industrial systems, and the ability to take ambiguous problems from zero to production. That combination can be difficult to acquire anywhere else early in a career - If you want to help build the intelligence layer for the physical world, come build it with us.

Compensation & Benefits

California base salary range: $150,000 – $190,000 USD (based on experience)

Equity in the form of stock options

Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage

401(k) participation

Generous PTO and company holidays

Ongoing learning and development opportunities

Avathon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Avathon is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us to discuss how we can assist you.
